proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/identification plate on the engine block (must be readable).
Send a short running video with audio (cold start if possible) showing no knock.
Send compression test and/or leak-down test results with readings (or have a mechanic do it on arrival).
Send photos proving completeness: all accessories/sensors included and counted.
If claiming “Belgium tokunbo” and mileage: provide any import/donor documentation or donor vehicle details that match the engine code.
